senses.definition: n.f. prob. row of olives or vines (so Du Buhl al.; cf. NH שׁוּרָה, JAram. שׁוּרְתָא row, whence mod. Arabic شورة as loan-word, cf. VogelstLandwirthschaft 41 f.);—pl. sf. שׁוּרֹתָם Jb 24:11 (al. ii. שׁוּר); Bu and Du del. sf.; here also Je 5:10 (reading שֻׁ׳) Du Buhl Dr, her (vine-)rows, but v. ii. שׁוּר.
